items.summary: fix: keep your message when the model changes in a chat that uses a context engine (#204887) * fix(agents): keep the user message when a prompt rebuild shortens history A system prompt rebuild retires earlier prompt-update rows from the live message list after the pre-prompt count was taken. With a context engine that owns its history, the loop hook then split the request one message late: the current user message fell on the engine-owned side and was replaced by stored history that did not contain it yet. Move the count with the retired rows, and never let the split place the admitted user message in engine-owned history. * fix: keep your message when the model changes in a chat that uses a context engine OpenClaw-Publication: 1a7c3081-0fdf-403c-a92b-d949686f6a9c

items.summary: fix: keep a session on its selected model when subagent results and other internal turns run (#204896) * fix(agents): run internal session turns on the session's inherited model A session without its own model pick inherits its parent's. Chat turns resolved that pick, but turns on the agent command path (subagent results, sessions_send, restart continuation) prepare a store holding only the session's own entry, so the parent lookup always missed and the turn ran on the agent default. Each provider flip restarted the pinned system prompt and discarded the prompt cache. The command model resolver now reads the parent entry on demand, and skips the read when the caller supplies a complete one-off override. * fix: keep a session on its selected model when subagent results and other internal turns run OpenClaw-Publication: f24dccea-2c5e-86a2-95ca-345d81d40dd7
